items.title: The vanishing and surjectivity statements hold for the extension by zero of a constant sheaf along an open of a reduced curve
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma removes the smoothness hypothesis from the companion statement for the extension by zero of a constant sheaf along an open of a reduced curve (statement lines 15565-15572). The proof (proof lines 15574-15602) uses the normalization of the curve, which is finite over X with smooth source, applies the smooth case there, pushes the statements forward along the finite morphism, and compares the two sheaves on the dense open where the normalization is an isomorphism using the restriction-to-open lemma. H2: one normalization reduction plus one comparison on a dense open, written out.
